generation.mode: single built-in image_gen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.jpg first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin full-angle land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and immediate neighbours excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell cast-shadow field is obvious, but basalt caps and bench tops are consistently pale while vertical column faces are materially darker. The aggregate statistic does not override this visible violation of the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame screen-space estimate as fractions of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad bench treads and the level approach and arch shelves count as buildable; exposed column faces and sharp scarps count as steep; talus, rubble, vegetation, carvings and biome-transition margins make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: Screen-space visual estimate with approximate uncertainty of plus or minus 0.08 per fraction, not an elevation-derived slope measurement.

crown.method: Full-frame native-resolution census of all 19 discernible conifer crowns, including saplings and clipped edge crowns; median full foliage-envelope width 22 source pixels scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution bank-to-bank span traces of the complete tarn surface and the connected south-edge stream, fall, spray and splash footprint, including pale wash, ripple highlights and reflections; the binary overlay was inspected over the raw source.

runeChain.visualRead: The nearest dry incisions are displaced from both registered seam positions and do not form one uninterrupted west-to-east slot. The western incision merges into the west-bench and fall system, repeating the explicitly prohibited termination defect.

transitionRuling.conflict: The opening summary asked for a north-third moor transition, while the later cell-specific transition table says the north neighbour is unauthored and directs bare plateau to the north edge.
transitionRuling.precedence: The later cell-specific transition table was followed because it is more specific to this exact neighbour state.
transitionRuling.westEastSouthApplied: authored settlement-shelf and bench-country paint continued inward before transitioning to bare plateau

refusalReasons: The automatic lighting failure applies: repeated pale rock caps and darker vertical column faces violate the required equal value on every side.

The rune chain is not one continuous dry bedrock slot at the registered west and east handoffs; the nearest dry segments are displaced and the western segment terminates into the fall and bench system.
The plateau tarn is approximately 10.5 metres across rather than about 30 metres.
The wind-arch opening is approximately 4.5 metres across rather than about 12 metres, and the north rock face also reads below the requested 15-to-20-metre rise.
The fall is not separated from the nearest rune-like incision by the required 15 metres.
positiveObservations: The source is one square whole-canvas edit at the minimum accepted generation size, with both required image inputs accepted and no resize, crop, retouch or second generation call.
The center is a bright bare pale-basalt plateau with three bench levels, scree, sparse crack vegetation, a complete shingle-rim tarn, an eastern natural arch and a north-facing solid rock rise.
Terrain reaches all four edges, the south-edge water handover remains connected, and no buildings, roads, rails, portals, bridges, figures or other built structures are present.
The complete 19-crown census has a median inside the required territory band and excludes nothing.
openRisks: The water mask is same-size, binary, hole-free and overlay-inspected; exact water-to-stone boundary placement remains a human visual gate.
The crown census includes every discernible crown, but overlapping or clipped painted foliage makes individual outer-envelope separation a manual judgment.
No shipped-canvas bake, runtime mount, public asset write, art-source write or owner visual acceptance was attempted because the result remains quarantine-only and fails binding visual constraints.
